_about: The collateral tables (docs/world/collateral-run.md; WorldCollateral), on structure mass since CD-05 (docs/design/bystanders.md section 2: nobody dies, so nothing counts people). budget: the structure mass a rolling 60 s admits to be brought down, by tier 1 to 4, as shares of the arena's structure mass at the stage's start (S.world.mass0, WorldBrunt.massOf summed); ceiling: the cumulative total, by tier; eventAllow: what one set piece of each kind may borrow beyond the window's room, by tier, as shares of the same mass. First values from 22 AI-against-AI matches by highest tier (docs/world/runs/): set above the window's 75th percentile and the total's 90th on the hand-made arena and on planet 7, so only the heaviest matches reach them; nothing is held back by them, they steer the launch planner (a chain that would break more than the room is marked down) and tell the QA band. massRef: the structure mass of the reference arena (the hand-made one), so a gain by mass reads the same on every planet. meterNorm is retired with the people it divided by. catastrophe: the mass-collapse set piece (Research); its allowance below tier 5 is zero.

bystanders._note: Nobody dies (docs/design/bystanders.md, Legal RL-257): people in the way scatter (run from a blow within scatterBh body heights, a body height being 75 units), or are flung (a hit, a fall, a crater opening under them: a keyed speed in flingSpeed units a second, up to bouncesMax bounces, on their feet within upWithinSec) and are never hurt, removed or counted. The sim decides who and how fast, keyed and seeded; the renderer draws the run and the bounce and never writes the sim.
